title: Eastville Comedy Club & Bar

services.name: Buy Tickets
services.desc: We run open mics (comedians sign up to perform) and booked shows (feature acts) throughout the week. Regular open mics are 1½ hours; micathon mics are 1 hour. Show slots are 1½ hours. Check the calendar below for exact dates and to buy tickets.Regular mics are 1 hour and a half long; micathon mics are an hour long.

services.name: Comedy Show Producers
services.desc: We offer producing slots to ambitious comedians who have an eye for talent and putting together a great show. This is a great way to make some cash as producers receive a percentage of tickets sold. Producing also gives comedians a platform for breaking into the NYC comedy circuit and enables them to perform alongside NYC’s top headliners. To be considered as a producer… enter a short bio and why you’d be a good producer in the contact form below. An EastVille Comedy Club representative will respond shortly.
